safePurpose: Annualise user-entered clinic, laboratory, transport, other care and confirmed-assistance amounts from monthly, quarterly, annual or once-in-12-months cadences.
privacy: Treat every amount and its HIV-care context as highly sensitive. Do not request status, medicine, regimen, clinic, programme, patient or contact identifiers and do not retain, log, upload, sync, email, network-send, add it to accounts or URLs, or send it to analytics.
disallowed: asking HIV status, viral load, medicine, regimen, adherence or missed-dose details
giving regimen, interruption, missed-dose or adherence advice
inventing country prices, programme coverage or eligibility
treating a monthly average as a bill schedule or forecast
recommending that care change because of cost
staticText: Private HIV Care Cost Worksheet for /tools/hiv-treatment-cost/. Explain only local arithmetic that annualises user-entered clinic, laboratory, transport, other care and confirmed-assistance amounts: monthly times 12, quarterly times 4, annual or once-in-the-next-12-months times 1; assistance is subtracted after annualisation and the net monthly average is the net annual total divided by 12. Do not ask HIV status, regimen, medicine, viral load, adherence, missed-dose, clinic, programme or patient details; give regimen, interruption, missed-dose or adherence advice; invent country prices, coverage or eligibility; call the monthly average a bill schedule or forecast; or recommend changing care because of cost. Treat all context as highly sensitive and local: do not retain, log, upload, sync, email, network-send, add it to accounts or URLs, or send it to analytics. Source reviewed 2026-07-26: WHO HIV and AIDS fact sheet (15 July 2025), used for health context and not prices.
